cause: The registered Panel OLS capability is executable from the manual run form, but model.genesis validation and its workflow executor treat every branch as OLS. A composed option also derives expected artifacts from one outer capability instead of the model family declared by each model step.

evidence.ref: CE5 UI completed a manual Panel OLS run, while backend/workbench/agent/workflow_runtime.py dispatches workbench.services.genesis to _execute_ols_branches and backend/workbench/agent/notebook/planning_agent.py derives multi-step artifacts from one capability_id.

impact: Notebook cannot safely propose, confirm, execute, and answer a general fixed-effects panel specification or a legitimate comparison between panel and dummy-fixed-effect estimators, despite both being server-registered capabilities.
lesson: A model capability is not Agent-available merely because the manual form can run it. Every model family must have an explicit workflow semantic contract, matching runtime materialization, result evidence, and per-step artifact admission.
